_readme: Frame-relative SFX cues, resolved against real frame starts by scripts/wire-audio.mjs.
Every cue names its word. The kit is synthesised (tools/sfx.sh), so there is no licence
to record. Dramaturgy (DIRECTION.md): a held tone follows the line and STOPS on the break
(01); then no music at all through the portal world (02-04): the silence is the problem.
At the turn the line comes back with a brighter tone (05 -> 09) that resolves into the
brand chord from film 1 on 'bontrivo'. Nothing repeats more than twice (zip-up x2).

01-bruch.word: Seit … laufen — the tone follows the running line and ends ON the break
keine — the line breaks at the portal

03-leere.word: ins Leere — the dead ends exhale once

05-direkt.word: Reservierungen — the cream wipe along the line
the line returns with its tone; fades into the chord in 09
direkt — the line lands in the O, the bean drops (olive 1/2)

07-preis.word: Neunundzwanzig — the price lands on the line

08-hamburg.word: Hamburg — the pin is set on the line

09-wechseln.word: bontrivo — the ring is closed: the brand chord
the bean lands in the notch (olive 2/2)
